#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

bool decide(int w, int m) {
    vector<int> digits;
    while (m != 0) {
        digits.push_back(m % w);
        m /= w;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)digits.size(); ++i) {
        int digit = digits[i];
        if (digit == 0 || digit == 1) {
            continue;
        }
        if (digit == w - 1) {
            int j = i + 1;
            while (j < (int)digits.size()) {
                int higher = digits[j];
                if (higher == w - 1) {
                    digits[j] = 0;
                } else {
                    digits[j] = higher + 1;
                    break;
                }
                ++j;
            }
            continue;
        }
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    cout << (decide(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
